title: Architect
subtitle: 本課集中處理 architect = a professional who designs buildings and helps plan architectural proje
description: 本課集中處理 architect = a professional who designs buildings and helps plan architectural projects。 這是一個專業職稱，因此真正可互換的詞不多；很多相關詞只是 descriptive paraphrase, broader occupation, or credential-specific subtype。為避免誤導，本課不會把 engineer, builder, draftsperson, interior designer 等相關職業硬當同義詞。

words.meaning: 建築設計師；建築物設計人員
words.example: The building designer revised the entrance to improve accessibility.
words.exampleZh: 建築設計師修改了入口設計，以改善無障礙通行。

exercises.original: The architect redesigned the entrance to improve accessibility.
exercises.zh: 建築師重新設計入口，以改善無障礙通行。

options.explanation: Building designer ✓ — a person who designs buildings or prepares building designs。本句關鍵是 the sentence focuses only on designing a building feature；因此 Building designer 最精準。
Architectural designer — a person who works on architectural design, drawings, concepts, and layouts。architectural designer 聚焦建築設計工作；在不同地區未必等同正式註冊 architect，因此有註冊／法定線索時不夠精準。
Qualified architect — an architect who has completed relevant professional qualification requirements。qualified architect 明確加入專業資格；如果原句只說一般設計工作，會無故增加 credential 意味。
Engineer — a professional who applies engineering principles to technical systems or structures。engineer 處理工程／技術問題，不能當作 architect 的同義詞。
Builder — a person or company responsible for construction。builder 負責施工／興建，不是建築設計專業身份。
Draftsperson — a person who prepares technical drawings。draftsperson 主要製作技術圖則，並不等於主導建築設計的 architect。

options.explanation: Building designer — a person who designs buildings or prepares building designs。building designer 很接近，但範圍較廣；有正式註冊、專業資格或 umbrella-category 線索時另有更精準詞。
Architectural designer — a person who works on architectural design, drawings, concepts, and layouts。architectural designer 聚焦建築設計工作；在不同地區未必等同正式註冊 architect，因此有註冊／法定線索時不夠精準。
Engineer — a professional who applies engineering principles to technical systems or structures。engineer 處理工程／技術問題，不能當作 architect 的同義詞。
Interior designer — a professional specialising in interior spaces。interior designer 主要處理室內空間，不等同整體建築設計。
Builder — a person or company responsible for construction。builder 負責施工／興建，不是建築設計專業身份。
Architectural professional ✓ — a professional working in architecture or architectural design。本句關鍵是 the sentence deliberately broadens beyond the protected title；因此 Architectural professional 最精準。

falseSynonyms.zh: 工程師 ≠ architect engineer 主要處理結構、系統、技術性能等工程問題；architect 主要負責建築設計與整合。
室內設計師 ≠ architect interior designer 主要處理室內空間；不等同整體建築設計專業身份。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Interior design is narrower.

falseSynonyms.zh: 繪圖員 ≠ architect draftsperson 主要製作技術圖則／圖面，不等於負責整體設計的 architect。
建造商／施工人員 ≠ architect builder 負責興建／施工；architect 負責設計、規劃及專業協調。
高度接近但較廣 building designer 可以設計建築，但未必具 architect 的專業註冊身份。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Building designer is broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 高度相關但職稱不完全等同 architectural designer 未必等同受規管／註冊 architect。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Title and qualification can differ.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在正式註冊身份 sense 接近 registered architect 是較窄的 credential-specific subtype。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Registration makes it narrower.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 architect 是人；architecture 是建築學／建築風格／建築體系。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Check person vs field.
